description: Danxbot mantra (zero-context continuity: all work lives on cards or the plan; always the ideal, correct, zero-tech-debt solution) on SessionStart with no matcher, so it re-injects after compaction, plus a one-line pointer on UserPromptSubmit. Then the plugin skill load mandate for danxbot autonomous dispatch + worker runtime environment (SessionStart). Plus the plan event bridge (DX-2784): one background process per session CONNECTED to a danxbot Plan, relaying the plan's dashboard events into the session inbox. It is started by an async PostToolUse hook on plan_connect, and by an async SessionStart hook only when the session is already connected; SessionEnd stops it.
